# Project governance

AegisDNS is an independent open-source project maintained by Harshil Anuwadia.

## Decisions

Routine changes are decided through issue and pull-request discussion. The maintainer makes the final decision when consensus is unclear, balancing security, privacy, reliability, maintenance cost, and the project's self-hosted purpose.

Security fixes, regressions, data-loss risks, and installation safety take priority over feature growth. Compatibility may be broken when retaining it would preserve unsafe behavior, but migrations should be documented and user data preserved whenever possible.

## Contributions and roles

Anyone may report issues, propose changes, review code, or improve documentation. Sustained contributors may receive additional repository responsibilities based on demonstrated judgment and project need. Access can be reduced when it is unused or presents a security risk.

Sponsorship does not purchase decision-making authority, private releases, user data, or exceptions to security and quality requirements.

## Changes to governance

Material governance changes are documented in the repository and reviewed publicly when circumstances permit. Urgent security or moderation actions may be taken privately first and explained later without exposing sensitive information.
